title: 第9章 孟氏一第10章 孟氏二
content_zh:
“她不是已经被你渡走了吗？”茶灵惊讶地指着女鬼杜若问君澜。
那女鬼忽然发出一阵低低的笑声，那笑声从喉咙深处挤出来，像生锈的铁门被缓缓推开，听得人牙根发酸。
君澜神色不变，只是抬手在虚空中一划。
指尖亮起一点莹白的光芒，那光芒起初只有米粒大小，转瞬便化作一圈圈涟漪，以女鬼为中心向外扩散。涟漪所过之处，空气像是被什么东西涤荡过一遍，那股阴森森的鬼气渐渐褪去，露出底下的本来面目。
女鬼的形体在光芒中剧烈地扭曲起来。
那张血肉模糊的脸开始变化——五官重新排列组合，像一幅被揉皱的画被人小心翼翼地展平。残破的皮肉重新愈合，翻卷的伤口一点一点合拢，露出底下的肌肤。
茶灵瞪大了眼睛。
光芒散去之后，站在原地的已经不再是杜若。
那是一个中年妇人，面容与杜若有五六分相似，但线条更柔和，眉眼间沉淀着岁月的风霜和一种说不清道不明的哀戚。她穿着一件半旧的藕荷色襦裙，发髻松松地挽着，鬓边簪着一支已经褪色的银簪。
她的身体依旧是半透明的，月光穿过她的身形落在青砖上，没有留下任何影子。
“你是谁？”茶灵吃惊地问那妇人。
妇人抬起头，看着茶灵，眼中所有的阴鸷与疯狂都消失了，取而代之的是一种近乎破碎的柔软。
“七娘……”
她喃喃着，朝茶灵飘了一步，伸出那双半透明的手，想去触碰茶灵的脸。
茶灵下意识地后退了半步，后背抵住了床柱。
妇人的手僵在半空中，指尖微微颤抖着。她看着茶灵脸上那警觉的神色，眼眶里涌出两行血泪，顺着苍白的脸颊往下淌，滴落在衣襟上，化作淡淡的红雾消散。
“七娘，我是娘啊。”孟氏的声音嘶哑得几乎听不清，“你不认得娘了吗？”
茶灵愣了一瞬。
她当然不认得。她是茶灵，不是杜若。但此刻面对一个母亲的眼泪，她不知道该说什么。
“她不是杜若。”一旁，君澜的声音响起。

孟氏猛地转过头，瞪着君澜，眼中的血泪硬生生止住了。
“杜若已死，你是知道的，”君澜的声音平静得像一潭死水，“是我将她的魂魄引去了忘川河畔，看着她喝下孟婆汤，过了奈何桥……”
孟氏的身体剧烈地颤抖起来。
君澜道：“她的魂魄已经入了轮回，来世投胎，与今生再无瓜葛。你留在这里，等不到她回来了。”
孟氏像是被抽去了所有的力气，整个人——不，整个鬼——软了下去，瘫坐在地上。
她没有哭出声，但血泪从眼眶里无声地涌出来，一滴一滴砸在地面上，晕开一小片暗红色的痕迹。
茶灵看着这一幕，心里酸涩得很。
她忍不住走上前去，在孟氏面前蹲下来，犹豫了一下，伸出手，轻轻覆在孟氏那双冰冷的手上。
“你别太伤心了，”茶灵安慰道，“她刚死不久，兴许你现在去地府，还能与她相遇。要是迟了，她去投胎了，你就再见不着她了。”
“是柳氏！！”
孟氏突然怒喊道。
她的眼中迸射出刻骨的恨意，那恨意像一团烧得正旺的火，灼热得足以焚毁一切。
“七娘一定是被柳氏那个贱人害死的！她害死我还不够，还害死七娘，我要那个贱人偿命！！”
“你说是柳氏害死了杜若？”茶灵皱眉。
content_en:
"Hasn't she already been ferried away by you?" Cha Ling pointed at the female ghost Du Ruo and asked Jun Lan in surprise.
The female ghost suddenly let out a low laugh. The laughter was squeezed out from the depth of her throat, like a rusty iron door being slowly pushed open. It made one's teeth feel sore.
Jun Lan's expression remained unchanged, and he just raised his hand to draw in the void.
A bit of bright white light shone on the fingertips. At first, the light was only the size of a grain of rice. In an instant, it turned into circles of ripples, spreading outward with the female ghost as the center. Wherever the ripples passed, the air seemed to be cleansed by something, and the gloomy ghostly aura gradually faded away, revealing the true face underneath.
The female ghost's body twisted violently in the light.
The bloody face began to change - the facial features were rearranged, like a crumpled painting being carefully flattened. The broken flesh healed again, and the rolled wounds closed bit by bit, revealing the skin underneath.
Cha Ling's eyes widened.
After the light dissipated, Du Ruo was no longer standing there.
She was a middle-aged woman, her face was fifty-six times similar to Du Ruo's, but her lines were softer, and there were years of wind and frost and an indescribable sadness between her brows and eyes. She wore a half-worn lotus-colored skirt, her hair was tied loosely in a bun, and there was a faded silver hairpin on her temples.
Her body was still translucent, and the moonlight passed through her figure and fell on the blue bricks, leaving no shadow.
"Who are you?" Cha Ling asked the woman in surprise.
The woman raised her head and looked at Cha Ling. All the evil and madness in her eyes disappeared, replaced by an almost broken softness.
"Qiniang..."
She murmured, took a step towards Cha Ling, stretched out her translucent hands, and wanted to touch Cha Ling's face.
Cha Ling subconsciously took half a step back and pressed her back against the bedpost.
The woman's hand froze in mid-air, her fingertips trembling slightly. She looked at the alert look on Cha Ling's face, and two lines of blood and tears welled up in her eyes, flowing down her pale cheeks, dripping on her clothes, and dissipating into a faint red mist.
"Qiniang, I am mother." Meng's voice was so hoarse that it was almost inaudible, "Don't you recognize mother?"
Cha Ling was stunned for a moment.
Of course she didn't recognize it. She is Cha Ling, not Du Ruo. But now faced with a mother's tears, she didn't know what to say.
"She is not Du Ruo." Jun Lan's voice sounded from the side.
Meng turned her head suddenly and glared at Jun Lan, the blood and tears in her eyes stopped abruptly.
"You know that Du Ruo is dead," Jun Lan's voice was as calm as a pool of stagnant water, "I was the one who led her soul to the bank of Wangchuan River, and watched her drink Mengpo soup and cross the Naihe Bridge..."
Meng's body trembled violently.
Jun Lan said: "Her soul has entered reincarnation, and will be reincarnated in the next life, and has nothing to do with this life. You stay here, and you won't wait until she comes back."
Meng seemed to have had all her strength drained away, and her whole person—no, her whole ghost—went limp and collapsed on the ground.
She didn't cry out, but tears of blood flowed out of her eyes silently, hitting the ground drop by drop, leaving a small dark red mark.
Cha Ling looked at this scene and felt very sad.
She couldn't help but walked forward, squatted down in front of Meng, hesitated for a moment, stretched out her hand, and gently covered Meng's cold hands.
"Don't be too sad," Cha Ling comforted. "She died not long ago. Maybe you can meet her when you go to the underworld now. If it's too late and she reincarnates, you won't be able to see her again."
"It's Liu!!"
Meng suddenly shouted angrily.
Her eyes burst out with deep-seated hatred, which was like a burning fire, hot enough to burn everything.
"Qiniang must have been killed by that bitch Liu! It's not enough for her to kill me, she also killed Qiniang. I want that bitch to pay for it with her life!!"
"You said it was Liu who killed Du Ruo?" Cha Ling frowned.
